title: Battlefield 1

verdict.summary: Battlefield 1 has no crossplay: PC, PlayStation and Xbox players each have their own servers.

notes: Battlefield 1 (2016) never got crossplay. PlayStation, Xbox and PC players can't play together, and progress doesn't carry over between them.
PS5 and Xbox Series X|S play the PS4 and Xbox One version through backward compatibility, so they share servers with PS4 and Xbox One players. Online play on Xbox needs Game Pass Essential or higher.
On PC, the Steam version needs an EA account and the EA app running in the background.

title: Teardown

verdict.summary: Teardown's online multiplayer has no crossplay: PC, PS5 and Xbox Series X|S players only play with others on the same platform.

notes: Multiplayer (up to 12 players) launched on PC first and reached PS5 and Xbox Series X|S as a free update on September 15, 2026. It covers co-op in the campaign plus versus modes and mods.
Tuxedo Labs says multiplayer doesn't support crossplay and they don't plan to add it. There's no cross-platform progression either; in multiplayer, everyone uses the host's campaign progress.
Online play on console needs PlayStation Plus (any tier) or Xbox Game Pass Core or higher.

title: Football Manager 26
notes: Football Manager 26 Console (released November 4, 2025) has cross-play between Xbox and PS5 players in Online Career. The Xbox Store lists it for Xbox One and Xbox Series X|S with cross-gen multiplayer.

The PC and Mac edition (Steam, Epic, Microsoft Store and PC Game Pass) is a separate game with its own network games; Sports Interactive only lists cross-play between Xbox and PS5. Whether PC players on different stores can join each other isn't confirmed.
Online play on Xbox needs Game Pass Essential or higher. FM26 Touch (Switch, Apple Arcade) and the Netflix mobile edition are separate versions.

title: Pummel Party

verdict.summary: Pummel Party has no crossplay: online lobbies on PC, PlayStation, Xbox and Switch each stay on their own platform.

notes: Online play for up to 8 players works on every version, but only with people on the same platform. Rebuilt Games hasn't made an official statement; no store listing mentions crossplay, and players on the Steam forums report that PC and console lobbies can't see each other.
The PS4 version (April 2024) also runs on PS5, and the Xbox One version runs on Xbox Series X|S. The Switch version came out in May 2024.
Console online play needs PS Plus, Xbox Game Pass Essential or higher, or Nintendo Switch Online.

title: Cuphead

verdict.summary: Cuphead has no crossplay because it has no online mode: its 2-player co-op is local only.

notes: Co-op is for two players on the same system, on every platform. There's no online multiplayer, so there's nothing to cross over.
On Steam, Remote Play Together lets a friend join your local co-op over the internet; only the host needs the game, and it works between Steam users only.
The PS4 version also runs on PS5.

title: Stellaris
notes: On PC, players who bought the game on Steam, GOG or the Microsoft Store/PC Game Pass can play multiplayer together. Everyone, including Steam players, has to start the game with the Cross Store Multiplayer option in the Paradox launcher's game settings.
There's no crossplay between PC and consoles, or between PlayStation and Xbox (Paradox, 2022). Stellaris: Console Edition is a separate version with online games for up to 4 players.

The Console Edition got a free native PS5 and Xbox Series X|S version on November 6, 2025. Whether PS4 and Xbox One copies can still join PS5 and Series games isn't confirmed. Console online play needs PS Plus or Xbox Game Pass Essential or higher.

title: XCOM 2

verdict.summary: XCOM 2 has no crossplay, and its online multiplayer was switched off for Windows Steam players in March 2022.

notes: XCOM 2's online mode is a 1v1 match. No store page or official source lists crossplay, so you can only play people on the same platform.

Firaxis retired multiplayer and Challenge Mode for the Windows Steam version on March 28, 2022. The Mac and Linux versions (ported by Feral) and the console versions weren't affected; Steam Deck players can switch to the native Linux build to keep online play.
The Xbox One version also runs on Xbox Series X|S; online play on Xbox needs Game Pass Essential or higher. The campaign is single-player only.

title: Enter the Gungeon

verdict.summary: Enter the Gungeon has no crossplay: co-op is local only on PC and consoles, and the online co-op added to the mobile version stays on mobile.

notes: On PC, PlayStation, Xbox and Switch, co-op is 2-player local only. On Steam, Remote Play Together lets a friend join over the internet between Steam users.

The iOS and Android version (August 2025) added official online co-op for the first time, with public and locked lobbies. It doesn't connect to PC or consoles, and whether iPhone and Android players can play each other isn't confirmed.
